technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with EMA golden cross and price above all major MAs, but overbought conditions (RSI 9, StochRSI, Williams %R) and negative AO momentum create pullback risk; moderate swing entry with caution on entry timing.

fundamental.summary: AEP shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 59 days present material risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (27/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity neutral with only small sales by junior members; no recent news data to confirm sentiment.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (384.0) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; utilities defensive but credit stress and earnings in 59 days create material headwinds.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with price above all major moving averages and strong uptrend structure (supertrend bullish, OBV rising, DC new highs) provides technical confirmation of momentum continuation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 9 at 75.66, StochRSI, Williams %R), negative AO momentum, VIX crisis regime (384.0), zero fundamental support, and earnings risk in 59 days create material pullback/reversal risk that outweighs technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure shows EMA golden cross and price above all major MAs, but overbought RSI (75.66) and negative AO momentum signal pullback risk at resistance. Existing AEP position and 30 open Utilities positions create sector concentration that reduces conviction.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (384.0) combined with earnings in 59 days and zero fundamental support (smart money composite score 0) creates material reversal risk; overbought technicals lack confirmation from momentum.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents bullish on structure but overbought; fundamental and risk agents strongly bearish; debate winner is bear with medium confidence.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding AEP with 30 existing Utilities positions (15% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing ticker exposure warrant avoidance of additional entry.
